name: WNBA_R3B_STRICT_PREFIX_FEATURE_FORGE_CONTRACT_V1
purpose: Forge one deterministic leakage-safe pregame feature row per eligible 2020-2025 WNBA regular-season target before any R3 family weighting, model fitting, threshold search, calibration or performance comparison.

development_scope.support_only_role: 2019 may contribute only finalized prior meetings to 2020 H2H_PREFIX; 2019 never becomes an R3 target row.

source_custody.2019_2020: Use only exact team-box and per-season schedule assets frozen in WNBA_R3B0_H2H_SUPPORT_CUSTODY_CERTIFICATION.json.
source_custody.2021_2025: Use only exact team-box and schedule-master assets frozen in WNBA_R1A4_STATIC_VERSIONED_DATASET_CERTIFICATION.json.

strict_daily_chokepoint.phase_1: For target date D, build and serialize every eligible target row from state containing only dates strictly earlier than D.
strict_daily_chokepoint.phase_2: Only after all date-D target rows are sealed may date-D score/stat values be projected and appended for later dates.
strict_daily_chokepoint.same_date_results: NEVER usable, regardless of actual tip/final ordering within date D.
strict_daily_chokepoint.target_self: NEVER present in its own feature prefix.

eligibility.base_requirement: Both target teams need at least one finalized current-season prior game with all traditional fields required by BASE_R2 and exact R3 families.
eligibility.cold_start: Exclude row and report; do not borrow previous-season ratings or season-end snapshots.
eligibility.missing_required_stat: Exclude row and report; never zero-fill.
eligibility.h2h_zero_meetings: Keep row with meetings=0 and winShare/avgMargin null.

base_r2_frozen_reference.recent_advanced_aliases: recentPace/recentOffRtg/recentDefRtg/recentNetRtg remain aliases of full current-season prefix values, matching frozen R2 fallback semantics.
base_r2_frozen_reference.recentPpg_recentWinPct: latest up to 10 current-season prior games
base_r2_frozen_reference.deployed_daysRest: calendar-day difference target date minus latest prior game date
base_r2_frozen_reference.deployed_isB2B_quirk: true iff the gap between latest and second-latest prior games is <=1 day; preserved only inside BASE_R2 reference.
base_r2_frozen_reference.b2bWasRoad: when deployed_isB2B_quirk is true, second-latest prior game was road
base_r2_frozen_reference.gamesLast7: prior current-season games dated >= target date minus 7 days
base_r2_frozen_reference.streak: signed current W/L run from latest prior final
base_r2_frozen_reference.sos: latest up to 10 opponent occurrences; each opponent uses its strict current-date prefix with 40% season + 60% latest-up-to-10 fallback off/def ratings; repeated opponents retain occurrence weighting.
base_r2_frozen_reference.travel: Exact deployed static franchise-coordinate Haversine semantics parsed from frozen travel.ts; home travel=0, away travel=away-franchise-to-home-franchise distance. This is not physical trip truth.
base_r2_frozen_reference.availability: Omitted from historical R3 rowset; historical unknown is not zero.

four_factors.allowed_profile: For each side also forge opponent-allowed values from paired opponent rows in its own prior games using identical formulas.
four_factors.aggregation_rule: Aggregate numerators and denominators across the selected prior-game window, then divide; do not average per-game percentages.

shot_profile_matchup.opponent_allowed: same quantities calculated from opponents' paired rows in games previously played by the target team

quality_adjusted_form.qualityAdjustedGameNet: one-game netRtg minus opponent pregame current-season netRtg known before that historical game's date; unavailable when opponent had no prior state.
quality_adjusted_form.qualityAdjustedRecent: mean qualityAdjustedGameNet across available latest 5 or 10 prior current-season games; null if none available.

h2h_prefix.season_window: target season plus immediately previous season only
h2h_prefix.date_rule: meeting date strictly earlier than target date
h2h_prefix.2019_usage: Only as previous-season support for 2020 targets.

fatigue_calendar_v2.trueDaysRest: target date minus latest prior current-season game date
fatigue_calendar_v2.priorGamesLast4Days: count prior games dated >= target date minus 4 days
fatigue_calendar_v2.priorGamesLast6Days: count prior games dated >= target date minus 6 days
fatigue_calendar_v2.actual_location_sequence: EXCLUDED_UNTIL_SEPARATE_CUSTODY; deployed static travel remains only in BASE_R2.

rowset_rules.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON Lines, sort_keys=true, compact separators, terminal newline
